title: ChEMBL hERG Expansion Started
content: Expanding from 655 TDC molecules to 16,320 ChEMBL molecules (25x larger)

title: ChEMBL hERG Dataset Statistics
content:
Dataset expanded from TDC to ChEMBL:
- Original TDC: 655 molecules
- ChEMBL added: ~15,665 molecules
- Final total: 16,320 molecules
- Train: 11,411 (69.9%)
- Valid: 1,636 (10.0%)
- Test: 3,273 (20.1%)
- Class balance: ~49% blockers, ~51% non-blockers (well balanced!)

title: Task for agent_a: Create training script
content:
Create gen12c_chembl.py that:
1. Loads data from data/chembl_herg/{train,valid,test}.csv
2. Uses same model architecture as gen12c.py
3. Trains on larger dataset
4. Saves model to gen12c_chembl_model.pkl
5. Reports metrics via this coordination system

title: Task for agent_b: Create evaluation script
content:
Create evaluate_chembl.py that:
1. Loads test data from data/chembl_herg/test.csv
2. Evaluates any HERGPredictor on ChEMBL test set
3. Reports ROC-AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, F1
4. Supports JSON output for automation
5. Reports results via this coordination system

title: evaluate_chembl.py already exists and is feature-complete. Tested with gen12c.py on ChEMBL data (16,320 molecules). Running evaluation takes ~10 minutes due to CV on large dataset. Script supports: --json, --cv-only, --cv-folds, --data-dir flags. Computes ROC-AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, F1. Compatible with any HERGPredictor implementation.
COMPLETE: Created and ran gen12c_chembl.py. Training Results: Train ROC-AUC=0.8853, Valid ROC-AUC=0.8136, Test ROC-AUC=0.8085. Model saved to gen12c_chembl_model.pkl

TASK COMPLETE: evaluate_chembl.py verified and working. Features: (1) Loads ChEMBL data from data/chembl_herg/{train,valid,test}.csv (2) Dynamic import of HERGPredictor class (3) Computes ROC-AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, F1 (4) Supports --json for machine-readable output (5) Supports --cv-folds N for cross-validation (6) Supports --cv-only for stability check only (7) Supports --data-dir for custom data location. Note: Full evaluation with CV takes ~12 minutes on the 16K molecule dataset. Script is compatible with gen12c.py and any HERGPredictor implementation.
ChEMBL baseline established: 0.8085 ROC-AUC on 16,320 molecules vs 0.890 on TDC 655 molecules
